governance.note: ERCOT-72 leg CS on the ERCOT-71 leg-A base: the measured DAM cleared-share offer boundary (ercot_offer_surface_cleared_share, default-off). Measurement yield: ERCOT has no DAM must-offer — on the May-2024 shoulder family 8.6 GW of CC live HSL (and 4.9 GW of CT) carried NO offer curve at any price (spinning AS on that headroom: 63 MW — AS withholding refuted; DA SPP cross-resource p10-p90 spread $18 on a $50 mean — congestion secondary). The measured cleared share is condition-responsive (CC 0.33 loose -> 0.64 tight) and stable across years (+/-0.03). Mechanism: econ* rows above the bin's measured cleared share floored at the bin's measured offered-but-uncleared wall; zero fitted scalars. ADJUDICATION: the covered-CC composition target is HIT EXACTLY (May-2024 shoulder CC excess +675 -> +15 MW; CT dispatch 1,260 -> 1,774 vs actual 1,370; CC share of live 0.872 -> 0.813) and May/Nov/2025-May move the right way (-6.9 -> -5.0, -4.2 -> -3.0, -5.8 -> -4.2), but the price formation stops at $32.7 vs $67.3: the walled CC gap overflows into the UNWALLED cheap committed rungs of ST_GAS (+640, drag-owned, rule 19) and CT, and the TIGHT-BIN arm blankets over-lift where reality's RUC/self-commitment brings the un-offered capacity online near cost (measured: Aug-2024 h14-19 RT CC 23.8 GW vs DA offered 18.0 / cleared 20.3) — 2023 C3a +4.7% -> +15.9% (Aug +25.8, Sep +28.0), 2024 flips -7.1% -> +5.0% with C3b 0.160 -> 0.174. The DA-participation cliff is real but STATE-DEPENDENT; a static bin ladder cannot carry the tight regime. Successor: the commitment-state (DA/RT) construction with a measured RUC series.
